dedupe_keys.name: a new process for the pragmatic choice of wind models in complex terrain quantification of skill score and cost

description: Sarah Barber and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed comparison applies simulation results from the Bolund blind experiment to investigate metrics of predictive skill and modelling cost. A broader decision tool for choosing wind-resource models is described as under development, with later demonstration planned. This record therefore represents the executed benchmark application, not a finished model-selection package. It supports assessment of accuracy and computational complexity under the stated benchmark conditions. Related Perdigao work is kept as a separate challenge application, without assuming identical solver configurations. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
